name: patchrelay
description: Agent skills for pairing Claude (and other agents) with the PatchRelay stack: review-quill for PR review, merge-steward for the merge queue.

plugins.name: ship-pr
plugins.description: Shepherd a non-draft PR through review-quill approval and merge-steward's merge queue with blocking --wait gates. React to requested changes, failing checks, and queue incidents instead of polling on a fixed cron.
